svg.title: SUAY: from request to response
svg.desc: Old computers, laptops, Raspberry Pi boards, phones and an edge computer exchange illustrative data around a SUAY gateway and server rack. A demonstration AI Agent web interface sits alongside. Five steps explain the implemented inference proxy; mixed-device compute remains experimental.
svg.text: More from the hardware you already own.
Explore shared local AI. Give every team a controlled way to build.
ILLUSTRATIVE UI / NOT A LIVE SESSION
No remote shell or desktop control.
Desktop / Laptop / Mobile / Pi / Edge / Server
A developer app submits a prompt with a scoped API key.
Petals LAN and Rust supervision are separate experiments. Device and model compatibility vary.
No automatic gateway-to-Petals integration or fleet command transport yet. No guaranteed savings.
